insights.title: Total assets, gross loans, customer deposits & growth
insights.whatItTells: The size and shape of the bank at a glance.
insights.method: Month-end GL balances: total assets, gross customer loans, customer deposits; MoM/YoY growth for each. Source: GL trial balance mapped to reporting lines.

insights.title: Net interest margin (NIM) & cost-to-income ratio (CIR)
insights.whatItTells: The two efficiency ratios every board watches.
insights.method: NIM = (interest income − interest expense) / average interest-earning assets, annualized. CIR = operating expenses / total operating income. Both from management P&L; compare vs budget and peers.

insights.title: ROE & ROA vs budget
insights.whatItTells: Return on shareholder capital and on the balance sheet.
insights.method: ROE = annualized net profit / average equity; ROA = annualized net profit / average total assets. Average = (opening + closing)/2 or 13-point monthly average. Source: P&L + balance sheet GL.

insights.title: LCR, NSFR & loan-to-deposit ratio
insights.whatItTells: Regulatory liquidity resilience.
insights.method: LCR = high-quality liquid assets / net cash outflows over 30-day stress (from regulatory reporting engine). NSFR = available stable funding / required stable funding. LDR = net customer loans / customer deposits. Gauges against the 100% regulatory floor and internal buffers. Source: regulatory reporting / ALM system.

insights.title: Capital adequacy ratio (CAR)
insights.whatItTells: Solvency headroom above the regulatory minimum.
insights.method: CAR = eligible capital (CET1 + AT1 + Tier 2) / risk-weighted assets; show CET1 separately; track vs minimum requirement + capital conservation buffer. Source: regulatory capital reporting.

insights.title: Retail vs Corporate vs Treasury revenue & asset split
insights.whatItTells: Where the bank makes its money and holds its risk.
insights.method: Divisional revenue (NII + fees) and divisional assets per management accounts allocation; share donut for current month + stacked bar trend over 12 months. Source: divisional P&L / management accounting.

insights.title: Group NPL ratio & coverage
insights.whatItTells: Bank-wide credit quality headline.
insights.method: Group NPL ratio = total Stage 3 / non-performing exposure / gross customer loans. Coverage = total ECL provisions / NPL stock. Split retail vs corporate. Source: ECL engine + GL.

insights.title: Budget vs actual P&L variance
insights.whatItTells: Execution against the financial plan.
insights.method: YTD actual per P&L line (NII, fee income, opex, provisions, net profit) vs budget; variance % = (actual − budget)/budget; waterfall decomposing the net-profit variance into its drivers. Source: management accounts + budget file.

insights.title: Total operating income & growth
insights.whatItTells: The bank's total revenue engine.
insights.method: Total operating income = net interest income + non-interest income, from the management P&L (GL income statement lines). MoM/YoY growth and YTD vs budget. Source: GL trial balance mapped to P&L lines.

insights.title: Net interest income (NII) & margin trend
insights.whatItTells: Core intermediation earnings and the spread driving them.
insights.method: NII = interest & similar income − interest & similar expense (GL). NIM = annualized NII / average interest-earning assets. Decompose NII change into volume effect (Δ balances × prior rate) and rate effect (Δ rate × current balances). Source: GL + average balances + FTP.

insights.title: Non-interest income breakdown & share
insights.whatItTells: Revenue diversification beyond lending spreads.
insights.method: Group GL non-interest lines: net fees & commissions, FX/trading income, investment income, other income. Fee share = non-interest income / total operating income; trend by component. Source: GL income accounts.

insights.title: Cost of funds & interest expense trend
insights.whatItTells: What the bank pays for its money and how fast it's repricing.
insights.method: Cost of funds = annualized interest expense / average interest-bearing liabilities; split by deposits (retail/corporate), interbank, debt issued; spread vs policy rate. Source: GL interest expense + average balances.

insights.title: Operating expenses & cost-to-income ratio
insights.whatItTells: Cost discipline of the whole institution.
insights.method: Opex = staff + premises + IT + other (GL cost lines). CIR = opex / operating income; trend and vs budget; cost growth vs income growth ('jaws ratio'). Source: GL cost centres.

insights.title: Provision charge & cost of risk
insights.whatItTells: How much credit losses eat into earnings.
insights.method: Cost of risk (bps) = annualized impairment charge (IFRS 9 P&L) / average gross loans. Trend quarterly; split retail vs corporate. Source: ECL engine + GL impairment lines.

insights.title: Net profit, ROE & ROA (trend & vs plan)
insights.whatItTells: Bottom-line delivery to shareholders.
insights.method: Net profit from P&L; ROE = annualized net profit / average equity; ROA = / average total assets; bullet vs budget and vs prior year. Source: management accounts.

insights.title: Profitability by product line (whole bank)
insights.whatItTells: Which products fund the institution across both divisions.
insights.method: Product-level contribution across retail AND corporate books: income − FTP cost − allocated opex − provisions, aggregated by product family. Source: profitability engine.

insights.title: Asset composition & deployment
insights.whatItTells: Where the balance sheet is invested.
insights.method: Month-end GL: customer loans (net), investment securities, interbank placements, cash & central bank, other assets; each as % of total assets; trend. Source: GL balance sheet mapping.

insights.title: Liability & funding composition
insights.whatItTells: How the bank funds itself.
insights.method: Month-end: customer deposits (retail/corporate), interbank borrowings, debt securities issued, other liabilities, equity; % of total; trend. Source: GL balance sheet mapping.

insights.title: Loan-to-deposit ratio (LDR) trend
insights.whatItTells: Balance between lending ambition and deposit funding.
insights.method: LDR = net customer loans / customer deposits; trend vs internal appetite band (e.g. 80–95%); split by division. Source: GL.

insights.title: Balance sheet growth & YoY bridge
insights.whatItTells: What drove the change in total assets.
insights.method: YoY movement in total assets decomposed into: loans growth, investments growth, interbank, other. Waterfall from opening to closing total assets. Source: GL snapshots.

insights.title: Total off-balance-sheet exposure
insights.whatItTells: Contingent commitments beyond the balance sheet.
insights.method: Undrawn commitments + guarantees + LCs + acceptances, retail and corporate combined; as % of total assets; trend. Source: contingent liability GL + facility/trade modules.

insights.title: Investment portfolio composition & accounting classification
insights.whatItTells: Size and risk profile of the securities book.
insights.method: Securities by type (sovereign, corporate, other) and by classification (amortized cost / FVOCI / FVTPL); unrealized gains/losses on FVOCI book. Source: treasury system + GL.

insights.title: Repricing gap (rate-sensitive assets vs liabilities)
insights.whatItTells: Earnings exposure to interest-rate moves.
insights.method: Bucket all rate-sensitive assets and liabilities by repricing date (<3M, 3–6M, 6–12M, 1–5Y, >5Y); gap per bucket = RSA − RSL; cumulative gap / total assets. Source: repricing schedules from ALM extract.

insights.title: NII sensitivity to rate shocks
insights.whatItTells: What ±100/200bps does to next year's earnings.
insights.method: Re-price gapped balances under parallel rate shocks: ΔNII = Σ(bucket gap × shock × time weight). Run ±100bps and ±200bps scenarios; express as % of budget NII. Source: ALM model on repricing data.

insights.title: Balance sheet currency composition & net open FX position
insights.whatItTells: Structural currency risk.
insights.method: Assets and liabilities by currency; net open position per currency = FX assets − FX liabilities ± off-BS; total NOP vs regulatory limit (% of capital). Source: GL currency dimension + treasury.

insights.title: Duration / maturity mismatch of the book
insights.whatItTells: Long-term rate risk in the balance sheet.
insights.method: Average residual maturity/duration of assets vs liabilities; maturity ladder of the whole balance sheet; gap beyond 1Y. Source: ALM maturity schedule.

insights.title: Interbank market activity & reliance
insights.whatItTells: Wholesale money-market footprint.
insights.method: Placements with / borrowings from banks: balances, average maturity, counterparty concentration; net interbank position trend. Source: treasury deals + GL.

insights.title: Trading & FX income
insights.whatItTells: Markets business contribution.
insights.method: Trading income = realized + unrealized gains on FVTPL + FX revaluation + FX customer spreads (GL/treasury); split flow (customer-driven) vs position-taking; trend. Source: treasury + GL.

insights.title: LCR & NSFR (regulatory liquidity)
insights.whatItTells: Survival under stress and structural funding stability.
insights.method: LCR = HQLA / net cash outflows over 30-day stress scenario; NSFR = available stable funding / required stable funding — both from the regulatory reporting engine on core banking flows. Gauges vs 100% floor and internal buffer. Source: ALM/regulatory engine.

insights.title: HQLA buffer composition & level
insights.whatItTells: Quality and size of the liquidity cushion.
insights.method: HQLA = cash + central bank reserves + Level 1/Level 2 eligible securities (net of haircuts); composition donut and absolute buffer vs 30-day outflows. Source: treasury + regulatory engine.

insights.title: Funding concentration (top depositors, whole bank)
insights.whatItTells: Bank-wide dependence on large funding providers.
insights.method: Top-10/20 depositors (retail + corporate combined, aggregated at group level) as % of total customer deposits; monthly trend with threshold alerts. Source: customer-level aggregated balances.

insights.title: Wholesale funding reliance & maturity profile
insights.whatItTells: Exposure to market-sensitive funding.
insights.method: Wholesale funding = interbank + debt issued + large corporate deposits above threshold; wholesale ratio = wholesale / total funding; maturity ladder of wholesale instruments. Source: GL + treasury.

insights.title: Deposit beta / rate pass-through
insights.whatItTells: How much of a rate hike reaches deposit pricing.
insights.method: Beta = Δ average deposit rate / Δ policy rate over a tightening or easing cycle, per product; used for ALM and pricing strategy. Source: deposit rate history + policy rate series.

insights.title: Liquidity early-warning dashboard
insights.whatItTells: Leading indicators before a liquidity squeeze.
insights.method: Composite of daily signals: large outflows, LDR drift, interbank rate paid vs market, deposit renewal rate, cash/ATM demand spikes. RAG status per indicator. Source: daily core banking extracts + treasury.

insights.title: CAR, CET1 & buffer headroom
insights.whatItTells: Solvency and room to grow.
insights.method: CAR = eligible capital / RWA; CET1 ratio separately; headroom = current CAR − (regulatory minimum + buffers); trend. Source: regulatory capital reporting.

insights.title: RWA breakdown by risk type & division
insights.whatItTells: What consumes the capital.
insights.method: RWA split: credit (retail / corporate / sovereign), market, operational; density = RWA / exposure per portfolio. Source: regulatory engine.

insights.title: Capital generation vs consumption
insights.whatItTells: Whether earnings fund growth organically.
insights.method: Quarterly: internal capital generation (retained earnings) vs RWA growth; implied sustainable asset growth = ROE × (1 − payout) / target CAR. Source: P&L + RWA series.

insights.title: Stress impact on capital (bank-wide scenarios)
insights.whatItTells: Capital resilience under adverse scenarios.
insights.method: Apply macro scenarios (GDP shock, rate shock, sector default): project provisions, RWA and capital → pro-forma CAR path over 2–3 years vs minimum. Source: stress-testing framework on core exposures.

insights.title: Total credit exposure & ECL by IFRS 9 stage
insights.whatItTells: The complete credit risk stock.
insights.method: Total exposure (loans + commitments + off-BS) mapped to Stage 1/2/3 with ECL per stage; coverage per stage; quarter-on-quarter migration value. Source: ECL engine.

insights.title: NPL formation & cures (flow view)
insights.whatItTells: Whether the NPL stock is being refilled faster than it's drained.
insights.method: Monthly: new NPL inflows + restructured additions − cures − upgrades − write-offs − recoveries = ΔNPL stock. Flow waterfall per month. Source: loan classification history.

insights.title: Bank-wide NPL ratio & coverage (with division split)
insights.whatItTells: Headline asset quality.
insights.method: NPL ratio = Stage 3 / gross loans, total and retail/corporate; coverage = ECL / Stage 3; trend 24 months. Source: ECL engine + GL.

insights.title: Past-due but not impaired trend
insights.whatItTells: The pipeline feeding future NPLs.
insights.method: Total exposure 1–89 days past due by bucket, retail + corporate, monthly trend; leading indicator vs NPL lag. Source: DPD snapshots.

insights.title: Concentration: sectors, groups, products (whole book)
insights.whatItTells: Aggregate concentration across both divisions.
insights.method: Total credit exposure by sector, by obligor group (top 20 vs capital), and by product — retail + corporate combined; HHI per dimension. Source: exposure aggregation.

insights.title: Write-offs & recoveries bank-wide
insights.whatItTells: Final losses and the salvage rate.
insights.method: Monthly write-offs (GL) and recovery collections; recovery rate = recoveries / opening written-off stock; net loss = write-offs − recoveries. Source: GL + collections.

insights.title: Restructured & forborne exposure (total)
insights.whatItTells: Total forbearance across the bank.
insights.method: All exposures with forbearance flag (retail + corporate); % of gross loans; performance of previously restructured book (re-default rate). Source: facility master + classification.

insights.title: Total transaction volumes & system load
insights.whatItTells: Operational throughput of the bank.
insights.method: Daily/monthly count of all transactions processed (all channels, retail + corporate + treasury settlements); peak-day volume; growth trend — capacity planning input. Source: transaction ledger + payment hub.

insights.title: Straight-through processing (STP) rate
insights.whatItTells: Automation level of operations.
insights.method: STP rate = transactions completed without manual intervention / total transactions, per process (payments, onboarding, trade); manual-touch volume = rework queue. Source: workflow/operations systems.

insights.title: Branch network performance (whole network)
insights.whatItTells: Total physical footprint productivity.
insights.method: Network totals: transactions, accounts opened, deposits, loans per branch; ranking and quartile analysis; revenue per branch vs cost per branch. Source: branch-coded core data + cost centres.

insights.title: Digital share of total transactions
insights.whatItTells: The single migration KPI for the whole bank.
insights.method: Digital share = (mobile + online + host-to-host transactions) / total transactions; monthly trend, retail and corporate lines on one chart. Source: transaction channel field.

insights.title: Revenue & cost per FTE
insights.whatItTells: Organizational productivity.
insights.method: Revenue per FTE = operating income / average headcount; cost per FTE = staff cost / headcount; trend vs peers. Source: P&L + HR headcount feed.

insights.title: Operational losses & incidents
insights.whatItTells: Cost of operational risk events.
insights.method: Count and gross/net loss of operational risk events by Basel event type (fraud, process, systems, legal); near-miss count; trend. Source: op-risk event log (fed by core banking incidents).

insights.title: Total customer base & total accounts (combined)
insights.whatItTells: The full franchise on one number.
insights.method: Total active customers (retail + corporate de-duplicated where a person is both) and total open accounts by product family; growth trend. Source: customer master + account master.

insights.title: New accounts opened bank-wide
insights.whatItTells: Total sales momentum across divisions.
insights.method: Count of all new accounts/facilities/cards opened per month, all products, split retail/corporate; vs target. Source: origination dates across product masters.

insights.title: Cross-division synergy metrics
insights.whatItTells: How well the two divisions feed each other.
insights.method: Payroll loop: corporate payroll clients → employee salary accounts → their deposits/loans/cards. Referral flows: corporate-introduced retail customers and vice versa; revenue from cross-division clients. Source: linkage keys between corporate payroll files and retail accounts.

insights.title: Total active digital users (retail + corporate)
insights.whatItTells: Bank-wide digital reach.
insights.method: MAU across mobile, online and corporate portal; penetration vs total customer base; login → transaction conversion. Source: digital platform logs.

insights.title: Customer complaints & service quality
insights.whatItTells: Voice of the customer as an operational signal.
insights.method: Complaints per 10k customers by category (fees, service, digital, cards); average resolution time; repeat-complaint rate. Source: CRM/complaints module linked to customer master.

insights.title: AML alerts & suspicious transaction reports
insights.whatItTells: Financial-crime workload and outcomes.
insights.method: Alerts generated by transaction-monitoring rules, alerts closed as false positive, cases escalated, STRs filed; alert-to-STR conversion. Source: AML system on top of transaction ledger.

insights.title: Large & threshold cash transactions
insights.whatItTells: Regulatory cash-reporting compliance.
insights.method: Count/value of cash transactions above regulatory reporting thresholds per month; % reported within deadline. Source: transaction ledger cash flags.

insights.title: Sanctions screening hits & blocked/frozen accounts
insights.whatItTells: Sanctions exposure handling.
insights.method: Screening hits (customer and payment), confirmed true matches, accounts frozen/unfrozen, value blocked. Source: sanctions screening engine + account status table.

insights.title: Regulatory reporting timeliness & data quality
insights.whatItTells: Whether the bank reports to the regulator on time and correctly.
insights.method: Reports submitted on time / total due; rejection/correction rate from regulator; data-quality exceptions (missing fields, breaks) in core extracts. Source: regulatory reporting log + DQ rules on extracts.

insights.title: Total active customers & growth (MoM/YoY)
insights.whatItTells: Size and momentum of the retail franchise — the base every other metric sits on.
insights.method: Count DISTINCT customer IDs with status = 'Active' in the customer master at month-end (active = at least one open account). Growth % = (Active(t) − Active(t−1)) / Active(t−1). Split 'New' (onboarding date falls within the month) vs 'Existing'. Source: customer master + account status table, monthly snapshot.

insights.title: New customer acquisition funnel (lead → application → KYC → activated)
insights.whatItTells: Where onboarding loses prospects and which stage needs fixing.
insights.method: Count customers reaching each stage in the period: leads (CRM), application started, application submitted, KYC approved, first account activated. Stage conversion % = customers in stage N+1 / customers in stage N. Source: origination/onboarding workflow logs.

insights.title: Customer attrition / churn rate & lost balances
insights.whatItTells: How fast the base is leaking and the funding that leaves with it.
insights.method: Churn rate = customers who closed all accounts or turned dormant in period / active customers at period start. Lost balances = average total deposit balance of churned customers over their last 3 active months. Source: account closure table + daily balance snapshots.

insights.title: Customer segmentation mix (mass / affluent / premium / payroll / youth)
insights.whatItTells: Composition of the base and whether the bank is moving up-market.
insights.method: Assign each customer to a segment using the bank's rule (e.g. by total relationship balance/AUM bands or salary flag). Segment % = customers in segment / total active customers. Track mix monthly. Source: customer master segment flag, or computed from aggregated relationship balances.

insights.title: Demographic profile (age, gender, geography, salary band)
insights.whatItTells: Who the customers actually are — drives product and channel strategy.
insights.method: Group active customers by age band (from date of birth in KYC), gender, governorate/region (address), and salary band (from salary credit amounts). Present as % of active base. Source: customer master (KYC) + salary credit transactions.

insights.title: Cohort retention (3/6/12-month survival of new customers)
insights.whatItTells: Whether newly acquired customers actually stay and transact.
insights.method: Group customers by onboarding month (cohort). For each cohort, retention at month n = cohort members with ≥1 customer-initiated transaction in month n / cohort size. Build for n = 3, 6, 12. Source: customer master onboarding date + transaction ledger.

insights.title: Dormant & inactive accounts trend
insights.whatItTells: Silent attrition — accounts that are technically open but economically dead.
insights.method: Account is dormant if no customer-initiated debit/credit (exclude interest & bank fees) for 90 or 180 days. Dormancy rate = dormant accounts / total open accounts; also sum balances sitting in dormant accounts. Source: transaction ledger last-activity date per account.

insights.title: Customer lifetime value (CLV) by segment & channel
insights.whatItTells: What a customer is worth — guides how much to spend acquiring and retaining them.
insights.method: CLV = (annual NII contribution + annual fee income − annual cost-to-serve − annual expected loss) × expected relationship lifetime in years. Practical proxy: 12-month rolling revenue per customer by segment and acquisition channel. Source: GL revenue mapped to accounts via FTP + cost allocation model.

insights.title: Products per customer (cross-holding index)
insights.whatItTells: Depth of relationship — the strongest predictor of retention and profitability.
insights.method: Count distinct active product families held per customer (deposits, personal loan, mortgage, auto, credit card, digital banking, bancassurance). Cross-holding index = Σ products held / total active customers. Compare by segment. Source: account/facility master linked at customer level.

insights.title: Channel behaviour mix (digital-only / branch-only / hybrid)
insights.whatItTells: How customers interact with the bank — feeds branch network and digital investment decisions.
insights.method: Classify each customer by dominant channel: digital-only (≥80% of transactions on mobile/online), branch-only (≥80% teller), hybrid (rest). Trend the % mix monthly. Source: transaction ledger channel field per customer.

insights.title: Total retail deposits trend (MoM/YoY growth)
insights.whatItTells: Core funding base and its trajectory.
insights.method: Month-end sum of all retail liability account balances (current, savings, term, call), reconciled to the GL control accounts. Growth = (Balance(t) − Balance(t−1)) / Balance(t−1) for MoM and vs t−12 for YoY. Source: daily balance snapshot aggregated to month-end.

insights.title: CASA ratio (current + savings share of deposits)
insights.whatItTells: Funding quality — cheap, sticky deposits vs expensive term money.
insights.method: CASA ratio = (current account balances + savings account balances) / total retail deposits. Compute on month-end balances and on monthly averages (average = mean of daily balances). Source: balance snapshots by product code.

insights.title: Deposit mix by product
insights.whatItTells: Structure of the liability book and product-level shifts.
insights.method: Sum month-end balances grouped by product code (current, savings, term deposits, call deposits, special schemes); express each as % of total. Source: account master product mapping + balances.

insights.title: Term deposit maturity ladder
insights.whatItTells: Upcoming repricing and runoff risk in the term book.
insights.method: Sum term deposit principal by contractual maturity month for the next 12 months. Flag any month where maturing amount > 15% of the total term book (concentration risk). Source: TD account master maturity date + principal.

insights.title: Term deposit flows (new / matured / withdrawn / rolled over)
insights.whatItTells: Whether the term book is actually being retained at maturity.
insights.method: Closing stock = opening stock + new placements − withdrawals at maturity − early withdrawals (rollover = maturity withdrawal + simultaneous new placement by same customer). Decompose monthly change into these components. Source: TD transaction table.

insights.title: Average balance per customer by segment
insights.whatItTells: Quality and depth of deposit relationships per segment.
insights.method: Average balance = total segment deposit balance (monthly average of daily balances) / active customers in segment. Trend by segment; compare vs target. Source: balance snapshots + customer segment mapping.

insights.title: Deposit concentration (top 1% / 5% of customers)
insights.whatItTells: Dependence on a small number of large depositors — a liquidity vulnerability.
insights.method: Rank retail customers by total deposit balance descending; compute cumulative share of deposits vs cumulative share of customers; report the top-1%, top-5% and top-10% shares. Source: customer-level aggregated balances.

insights.title: Cost of deposits vs benchmark rate
insights.whatItTells: What the funding actually costs and its spread to market rates.
insights.method: Cost of deposits = retail deposit interest expense (from GL, monthly accrual) / average retail deposit balance for the month, annualized (× 365/days). Plot against central bank policy rate or benchmark. Source: GL interest expense accounts + average balances.

insights.title: Deposit stickiness / stability indicators
insights.whatItTells: Which balances will survive a stress — key input to liquidity risk.
insights.method: Balance volatility = standard deviation of daily balances / average daily balance, per segment, per month. Salary-account stability = % of salary-flagged accounts that received a salary credit in each of the last 3 months. Source: daily balances + salary transactions.

insights.title: Rate-sensitive deposits repricing exposure
insights.whatItTells: How fast funding costs reprice when rates move.
insights.method: Bucket balances by next repricing/reset period: <1M, 1–3M, 3–6M, 6–12M, >12M, non-maturing (CASA treated as overnight or per behavioural model). Sum per bucket; % of total. Source: account repricing date fields.

insights.title: Loan book size & growth by product
insights.whatItTells: Scale and trajectory of the retail asset book.
insights.method: Month-end outstanding principal by product (personal, auto, mortgage, credit-card receivables), reconciled to GL. Growth MoM/YoY per product and total. Source: loan account master + balance snapshots.

insights.title: New loan originations (volume & value) with approval rate
insights.whatItTells: Sales engine output and credit policy tightness.
insights.method: Originations = count and sum of loans disbursed with value date in the month. Approval rate = approved applications / decided applications (approved + declined; exclude customer-withdrawn). Source: origination system + disbursement table.

insights.title: Application funnel per product (applied → approved → disbursed)
insights.whatItTells: Where credit demand leaks between application and booking.
insights.method: Per product: count applications received → credit-approved → offer accepted → disbursed. Stage conversion % = N+1 / N; identify the biggest drop-off stage. Source: loan origination workflow logs.

insights.title: Average ticket size & tenor distribution
insights.whatItTells: Shape of new lending — small-short vs large-long.
insights.method: For loans disbursed in the period: distribution (P25, median, P75) of original principal and original tenor in months. Slice by product. Source: loan master original terms.

insights.title: Credit card portfolio: active rate, utilization, revolve rate
insights.whatItTells: Health and profitability of the card book in three numbers.
insights.method: Active rate = cards with ≥1 transaction in last 90 days / total issued cards. Utilization = total outstanding / total credit limits. Revolve rate = balances of cardholders paying less than full statement balance / total outstanding. Source: card management system.

insights.title: Mortgage book: LTV distribution & fixed vs variable split
insights.whatItTells: Collateral risk and rate sensitivity of the biggest retail asset.
insights.method: Current LTV = current outstanding / latest property valuation (fallback: original LTV). Bucket: <50%, 50–70%, 70–80%, 80–90%, >90%; show exposure per bucket. Fixed/variable split from interest-type field. Source: mortgage master + collateral table.

insights.title: Rejection analysis by reason & segment
insights.whatItTells: Why the bank says no — and whether good business is being declined.
insights.method: Count declined applications by decline reason code (score, income, DSR, policy, documentation); Pareto the reasons; slice by segment and score band. Source: origination decision log.

insights.title: Prepayment / early-settlement rate
insights.whatItTells: How fast the book runs off before maturity — hits margin and reinvestment risk.
insights.method: Monthly prepayment rate = early full/partial settlement principal in month / average outstanding book. Annualize (×12) as a CPR-style proxy. Source: settlement transactions flagged 'early'.

insights.title: Product yield & margin (NIM by product)
insights.whatItTells: Whether each lending product earns its spread.
insights.method: Gross yield = interest income (GL, accrual) per product / average outstanding, annualized. Product margin = gross yield − cost of funds (FTP rate for matching tenor). Source: GL interest income + FTP engine.

insights.title: Restructured / rescheduled retail loans
insights.whatItTells: Hidden stress — problem loans kept alive by modifying terms.
insights.method: Outstanding of loans carrying a restructure flag (tenor extension, rate relief, rescheduling due to financial difficulty); % of gross retail book; monthly trend and new restructures added per month. Source: loan master restructure flag.

insights.title: Card spend volume/value by type & merchant category
insights.whatItTells: What customers spend on — drives card product and merchant strategy.
insights.method: Sum count and value of card transactions by type (POS, e-commerce, ATM) and by merchant category code (MCC) group (grocery, fuel, dining, travel…). Monthly trend. Source: card switch / transaction authorization log.

insights.title: Interchange & card fee income per product
insights.whatItTells: Non-interest revenue engine of the card business.
insights.method: Interchange and card fees from GL fee income accounts mapped to card products; per active card = fee income / active cards. Source: GL fee accounts + card system.

insights.title: Transactions per active customer
insights.whatItTells: Engagement depth — the bank's place in the customer's daily life.
insights.method: Customer-initiated transactions in month (all channels) / active customers; segment the ratio; trend. Source: transaction ledger excluding system-generated entries.

insights.title: Salary inflows & post-salary spend pattern
insights.whatItTells: The payroll franchise: money in, and where it flows out.
insights.method: Identify salary credits (employer code / narrative pattern). Salary inflow = sum of salary credits per month. Post-salary spend = debits within 10 days of salary date, grouped by category (transfers, cards, cash, bill pay). Source: transaction ledger.

insights.title: Peak transaction times & seasonality
insights.whatItTells: When load hits systems and branches — capacity and marketing timing.
insights.method: Count transactions by hour-of-day × day-of-week from transaction timestamps; also month-of-year seasonality index = month volume / average month. Source: transaction ledger timestamps.

insights.title: Cash vs cashless trend
insights.whatItTells: Progress of the cashless agenda and pressure on the ATM/branch network.
insights.method: Cash = ATM/counter withdrawal value per month. Cashless = POS + e-commerce + transfers value. Plot both lines and the cashless share = cashless / (cash + cashless). Source: transaction ledger by type.

insights.title: Digital penetration (MAU/DAU) & adoption curve
insights.whatItTells: Digital banking reach — the headline digital KPI.
insights.method: MAU = distinct customers with ≥1 login or transaction on mobile/online in the month. DAU = same per day. Penetration = MAU / active customers; stickiness = DAU / MAU. Source: digital banking platform logs joined to customer master.

insights.title: Channel migration (branch → digital)
insights.whatItTells: Whether transactions are actually shifting to cheaper channels.
insights.method: Share of total transaction count per channel (branch teller, ATM, mobile, online, POS) per month; track the digital share trend. Source: transaction ledger channel field.

insights.title: Cost per transaction by channel
insights.whatItTells: The economic case for digital migration.
insights.method: Cost per transaction = fully-loaded monthly channel cost (branch: premises+staff allocated; ATM: fleet cost; digital: platform run cost) / transactions processed on that channel. Source: cost centre GL + transaction counts.

insights.title: Branch productivity & profitability
insights.whatItTells: Which branches earn their keep.
insights.method: Per branch: accounts opened, deposit balances, loans booked, revenue; divide by branch FTE; compute branch-level contribution (revenue − direct costs). Rank. Source: branch code on accounts/facilities + cost centre GL.

insights.title: ATM network performance
insights.whatItTells: Availability and efficiency of the self-service fleet.
insights.method: Uptime % = available hours / total hours per ATM. Transactions per ATM per day. Cash-out incidents = count of out-of-cash events. Show per site and network average. Source: ATM monitoring system.

insights.title: Digital onboarding volume & drop-off
insights.whatItTells: Whether customers can join without a branch visit.
insights.method: Accounts opened via digital channels vs branch per month. Drop-off = (applications started − completed) / started, measured per onboarding step to find the friction point. Source: digital onboarding platform logs.

insights.title: NPL ratio & NPL stock by product
insights.whatItTells: Credit quality headline for the retail book.
insights.method: NPL = loans 90+ days past due or otherwise classified non-performing per local regulator definition. NPL ratio = NPL stock / gross retail loans. Trend both the ratio and the value by product. Source: loan master DPD field + classification table.

insights.title: Delinquency buckets & roll rates
insights.whatItTells: Early warning — delinquency deteriorates months before NPLs show it.
insights.method: Outstanding by days-past-due bucket (current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+). Roll rate = balance moving from bucket n to bucket n+1 during the month / prior-month bucket n balance. Source: monthly DPD snapshots.

insights.title: Vintage analysis (default by origination month)
insights.whatItTells: Whether recent underwriting is better or worse than older vintages.
insights.method: For each origination-month cohort: cumulative 90+ DPD balance / cohort's original disbursed amount, measured at 3, 6, 9, 12 months-on-book. Plot one curve per cohort and compare at equal age. Source: loan master + DPD history.

insights.title: Credit score distribution — new vs existing book
insights.whatItTells: Risk appetite drift in new lending.
insights.method: Histogram of bureau/internal scores for approvals in the period vs the stock of the book; watch migration toward lower score bands; report % of new lending below policy cutoff+margin. Source: origination score field.

insights.title: Collections performance (cure, recovery, PTP kept)
insights.whatItTells: Whether the collections machine works.
insights.method: Cure rate = accounts moving from delinquent to current in month / delinquent accounts at start. Recovery rate = cash collected / balance allocated to collections. PTP kept = promises-to-pay honoured / promises made. Source: collections system.

insights.title: Write-offs & provisioning trend
insights.whatItTells: Realized losses and the buffer against future ones.
insights.method: Monthly write-off value (GL) and provision charge. Coverage ratio = total ECL provisions / NPL stock. Trend all three. Source: GL write-off and provision accounts + ECL engine.

insights.title: Fraud incidents & losses by type/channel
insights.whatItTells: Fraud pressure and where controls are failing.
insights.method: Confirmed fraud cases and gross/net losses by type (card-not-present, skimming, phishing, account takeover) and channel; incidents per 10k active cards as intensity metric. Source: fraud management system.

insights.title: Revenue per customer by segment
insights.whatItTells: Which segments actually pay for themselves.
insights.method: Revenue per customer = (NII allocated via FTP + direct fee income) / active customers, per segment. NII allocation: account balance × (customer rate − FTP). Source: FTP engine + GL fee mapping.

insights.title: Product-level P&L contribution
insights.whatItTells: Full profitability per product after all costs and risk.
insights.method: Per product: interest income + fee income − FTP funding cost − direct operating cost allocation − provision charge = product contribution. Build monthly and YTD. Source: management accounting / profitability engine.

insights.title: Fee income breakdown
insights.whatItTells: Diversification of retail non-interest income.
insights.method: Group GL fee lines: account maintenance, card fees, FX & remittances, late fees, bancassurance commissions; each as % of total retail fees; trend. Source: GL fee income accounts.

insights.title: Cost-to-serve vs revenue per customer
insights.whatItTells: The unprofitable tail — how many customers cost more than they bring.
insights.method: Cost-to-serve per customer = (channel costs + product opex allocated) / active customers per segment. Scatter each segment/customer decile: x = revenue per customer, y = cost per customer; diagonal = break-even. Source: activity-based costing model.

insights.title: Campaign ROI & response rate
insights.whatItTells: Whether marketing spend generates balances, not just noise.
insights.method: Response rate = customers taking the offer / targeted customers. Incremental uplift = average balance/volume change in target group minus change in matched control group. ROI = annualized incremental margin / campaign cost. Source: campaign platform + balance snapshots.

insights.title: Active corporate clients by segment & sector
insights.whatItTells: Shape of the corporate franchise.
insights.method: Count customers with status active AND (at least one live facility OR deposit account), grouped by segment (large corporate / mid-cap / SME) and sector (industry classification code). Source: corporate customer master + facility master.

insights.title: New-to-bank clients & onboarding cycle time
insights.whatItTells: Acquisition engine and onboarding friction for corporates.
insights.method: New-to-bank = relationships whose first facility/account opened in the period. Cycle time = calendar days from complete application to first drawdown/activation; report average and P90. Source: origination/CRM + facility master dates.

insights.title: Client attrition & lost revenue
insights.whatItTells: Relationships quietly leaving and the P&L walking out with them.
insights.method: Attrited = clients with all facilities closed and balances ~zero for 3+ consecutive months. Lost revenue = trailing 12-month revenue of attrited clients. Reason codes from RM exit notes. Source: customer master + revenue mapping.

insights.title: Relationship Manager (RM) scorecard
insights.whatItTells: Per-RM commercial performance and accountability.
insights.method: Per RM portfolio: total commitments, drawn outstanding, deposits, revenue (NII + fees), NPL %, new clients won. Compare vs individual targets. Source: RM ownership field on customer master + product aggregates.

insights.title: Share of wallet per client
insights.whatItTells: Headroom inside existing relationships.
insights.method: Share of wallet = RTB total exposure (or deposits) / client's total banking exposure across all banks — from credit bureau corporate reports where available, else RM estimates reviewed annually. Track for top-100 clients. Source: bureau + internal exposure.

insights.title: Products per relationship (cross-sell matrix)
insights.whatItTells: Relationship depth and white-space for cross-sell.
insights.method: Count distinct product families per client: credit, deposits, trade finance, cash management, FX, treasury/hedging. Heatmap of client tier × product family holding %. Source: product masters joined at group/customer level.

insights.title: Client profitability concentration (Pareto)
insights.whatItTells: How much of corporate profit depends on how few clients.
insights.method: Rank clients by annual contribution (revenue − FTP funding cost − expected loss − allocated cost); plot cumulative % of contribution vs cumulative % of clients; report top-20% share. Source: profitability engine.

insights.title: Dormant credit lines & inactive relationships
insights.whatItTells: Committed capital earning nothing.
insights.method: Approved, undrawn limits with zero utilization for 6+ months: count and value, per RM. Also relationships with no revenue-generating activity in 12 months. Source: facility master utilization history.

insights.title: Loan book by facility type
insights.whatItTells: Composition of the corporate asset engine.
insights.method: Month-end outstanding by facility type (overdraft/working capital, term loan, project finance, real estate, syndicated share), reconciled to GL. Growth per type. Source: facility master + balances.

insights.title: Sector / industry concentration
insights.whatItTells: Whether the book is dangerously skewed to one industry.
insights.method: Exposure (drawn + undrawn commitments) by sector as % of corporate book; add Herfindahl index HHI = Σ(sector share)² as a single concentration metric; alert when a sector exceeds internal cap. Source: facility master sector code.

insights.title: Committed vs utilized limits (utilization rate)
insights.whatItTells: Capital efficiency — undrawn commitments carry cost and risk.
insights.method: Utilization = drawn outstanding / approved committed limit, per facility; aggregate exposure-weighted per segment and sector. Persistently low utilization (<20%) = repricing or limit-reduction candidates. Source: facility master limits + balances.

insights.title: Disbursements, renewals & repayments flow
insights.whatItTells: Gross vs net growth of the book.
insights.method: Monthly: new-money disbursements (new facilities), renewals (re-booked existing limits), repayments/prepayments. Net growth = disbursements − repayments. Source: facility transaction ledger.

insights.title: Maturity & repricing profile
insights.whatItTells: Refinancing wall and interest-rate sensitivity of the book.
insights.method: Outstanding by residual maturity bucket (<1Y, 1–3Y, 3–5Y, >5Y) and by next repricing date bucket (floating vs fixed, reset within 3/6/12 months). Source: facility master maturity & repricing fields.

insights.title: Risk-based pricing effectiveness
insights.whatItTells: Whether riskier clients actually pay more.
insights.method: Scatter per client: x = internal rating (PD band), y = effective yield = annualized interest income / average outstanding. Clients below the rating-yield curve are underpriced. Source: rating system + FTP/GL income.

insights.title: Syndicated / club deal participation
insights.whatItTells: Role in the wholesale lending market.
insights.method: Facilities flagged as syndicated/club (bank not sole lender): count, bank's share value, fee income (arrangement/participation). Source: facility master syndication flag.

insights.title: Covenant compliance status
insights.whatItTells: Early-warning discipline on loan conditions.
insights.method: Facilities with covenants: due-for-testing, tested-pass, tested-breach. Breach rate = facilities in breach / facilities tested in period; aging of unresolved breaches. Source: covenant tracking module.

insights.title: Collateral coverage
insights.whatItTells: Second-way-out protection behind the corporate book.
insights.method: Coverage ratio = latest collateral valuation / exposure, per facility; mix by collateral type (real estate, cash, guarantees, movables); unsecured % = exposure with no registered collateral / total corporate exposure. Source: collateral management system.

insights.title: Single-name & group concentration vs capital
insights.whatItTells: Regulatory and survival-level exposure limits.
insights.method: Top-20 single names/groups: exposure (drawn + undrawn + off-balance-sheet) / eligible capital; compare vs regulatory single-name limit (typically 25% of capital). Source: exposure aggregation at group level + regulatory capital.

insights.title: Corporate deposit balances by segment & sector
insights.whatItTells: The liability side of corporate relationships.
insights.method: Month-end corporate liability balances grouped by segment and sector; share of total bank deposits. Source: account master (corporate flag) + balances.

insights.title: Operating vs non-operating balances
insights.whatItTells: How much of the funding is behaviourally stable.
insights.method: Operating balances = deposits of clients with active cash-management/payroll/collections linkage (transaction-driven, stable); non-operating = rate-sensitive surplus funds. Classify by product linkage and transaction activity; report operating %. Source: cash-management product flags + transaction behaviour.

insights.title: Top-10 depositor concentration
insights.whatItTells: Liquidity cliff risk from a few large names.
insights.method: Top-10 corporate deposit balances / total corporate deposits; monthly monitoring with alert above internal threshold (e.g. 30%). Source: customer-level aggregated balances.

insights.title: Average cost of corporate funds vs benchmark
insights.whatItTells: What corporate funding costs relative to market.
insights.method: Cost = interest expense on corporate deposits (GL) / average corporate deposit balance, annualized; spread vs policy/benchmark rate. Source: GL + average balances.

insights.title: Margin / lien / escrow deposits tied to facilities
insights.whatItTells: Sticky but encumbered deposits backing credit exposure.
insights.method: Balances flagged as margin deposits (LC/guarantee cover), lien-held against facilities, or escrow; value and % of corporate deposits. Source: account master lien/margin flags.

insights.title: Large withdrawal / deposit attrition alerts
insights.whatItTells: Real-time tripwires on funding flight.
insights.method: Exception list: corporate accounts with outflows > X% of prior 3-month average balance, or any single outflow above an absolute threshold, in the period. Source: transaction ledger on corporate liability accounts.

insights.title: Trade finance volumes (LCs, collections, guarantees)
insights.whatItTells: Activity level of the trade business.
insights.method: Monthly count and face value of: import LCs issued, export LCs advised, documentary collections, guarantees issued. Source: trade finance module.

insights.title: Trade finance fee income & yield
insights.whatItTells: Returns on trade activity.
insights.method: Trade commissions from GL fee accounts; fee yield = annualized trade fees / average outstanding trade volume; trend by product. Source: GL + trade module volumes.

insights.title: LC utilization & expiry analysis
insights.whatItTells: Whether issued LCs are actually used (unused LCs = contingent risk with no income).
insights.method: Utilization = total drawings under LCs / LC face value. Expired-unused rate = LCs expired with zero drawings / LCs issued in period. Source: trade module drawing events.

insights.title: Bank guarantees outstanding by type & sector
insights.whatItTells: Contingent exposure stock and where it sits.
insights.method: Outstanding guarantee exposure (face value) by type — bid bond, performance, advance payment, financial — and by sector. Source: guarantee module.

insights.title: Guarantee crystallization (claims) rate
insights.whatItTells: How often guarantees turn into real losses — an underwriting quality signal.
insights.method: Claims rate = guarantees claimed/paid in period / guarantees matured in period; also claims paid / average outstanding guarantee stock. Trend. Source: guarantee claims log.

insights.title: Trade corridors (country / currency flows)
insights.whatItTells: Geographic and currency footprint of trade business.
insights.method: Trade volume grouped by counterparty country and transaction currency; FX income attached per corridor. Source: trade module country/currency fields.

insights.title: Off-balance-sheet exposure composition
insights.whatItTells: The full contingent liability picture.
insights.method: Total off-BS = undrawn irrevocable commitments + outstanding LCs + outstanding guarantees + acceptances; composition and % of total assets; reconciled to contingent liability GL. Source: GL + trade/facility modules.

insights.title: Corporate payment volumes (transfers, bulk, payroll files)
insights.whatItTells: Transaction banking throughput.
insights.method: Monthly count and value of corporate-initiated payments by type (internal transfer, local ACH/RTGS, international, bulk/salary files). Source: payment hub.

insights.title: Cash management product penetration
insights.whatItTells: Adoption of the stickiest corporate products.
insights.method: Penetration = corporate clients with an active cash-management product (collections, sweeping, liquidity management, host-to-host) / total active corporate clients; by segment. Source: product holdings.

insights.title: Payroll processing & retail cross-sell loop
insights.whatItTells: The corporate-to-retail feeder machine.
insights.method: Count corporate payroll clients and salary files processed; count employee salary accounts opened and their retained deposit balances; loop metric = retail deposits from payroll employees / payroll value processed. Source: payroll files + retail account master.

insights.title: FX volumes & FX income by client tier
insights.whatItTells: Currency business contribution per relationship tier.
insights.method: FX deal count and volume per client tier; FX income = Σ (customer rate − interbank rate at deal time) × deal volume. Source: treasury/FX system.

insights.title: Corporate channel usage (host-to-host / portal / branch)
insights.whatItTells: Digital adoption on the corporate side.
insights.method: Share of corporate transaction count/value by origination channel: host-to-host/sFTP, corporate web portal, branch/manual. Trend. Source: payment hub channel field.

insights.title: Risk rating distribution & migration
insights.whatItTells: Credit quality structure and its direction of travel.
insights.method: Exposure-weighted distribution across internal rating grades; quarterly migration matrix: % of exposure moving from grade i to grade j. Net upgrade/downgrade drift. Source: rating system snapshots.

insights.title: Watchlist & early-warning exposure
insights.whatItTells: Tomorrow's NPLs, visible today.
insights.method: Exposure on accounts triggered by early-warning rules: rating downgrade, 30+ DPD, covenant breach, adverse bureau/news, limit excesses. Count and value by trigger type; aging on watchlist. Source: EWS engine.

insights.title: NPL ratio & IFRS 9 stage migration
insights.whatItTells: Regulatory credit quality view.
insights.method: Stage 1/2/3 exposure and ECL per IFRS 9 staging; NPL ratio = Stage 3 / gross corporate exposure; exposure migrating between stages between reporting dates. Source: ECL/staging engine.

insights.title: Provisioning coverage ratio
insights.whatItTells: Cushion against recognized problem loans.
insights.method: Coverage = Stage 3 ECL provisions / Stage 3 exposure, per segment and sector; compare vs internal policy floor. Source: ECL engine.

insights.title: Restructured facilities trend
insights.whatItTells: Forborne exposure — stress that hasn't hit NPL yet.
insights.method: Facilities with restructuring flag (modified terms due to financial difficulty): stock, % of corporate book, new restructures per quarter. Source: facility master flag.

insights.title: Sector risk heatmap
insights.whatItTells: One screen to compare industry risk.
insights.method: Matrix: sector × metric (NPL %, 30+ past-due %, downgrade %, watchlist share, internal outlook score); color-coded RAG. Source: aggregates from risk systems.

insights.title: Overdue limits & expired credit reviews
insights.whatItTells: Operational credit hygiene.
insights.method: Count and exposure of facilities past limit-expiry date and relationships whose annual review is > 12 months old, per RM/team. Source: limit management system review dates.

insights.title: Stress-test impact scenarios
insights.whatItTells: What a bad year would do to the book and capital.
insights.method: Apply defined shocks (e.g. +200bps rates, sector-specific default spike, FX depreciation): re-estimate PDs → projected NPL formation, ECL and capital consumption per scenario; show delta vs base case. Source: risk models on top of exposure data.

insights.title: Revenue per relationship
insights.whatItTells: Total economic value of each client.
insights.method: Per client: FTP-adjusted NII + lending fees + trade commissions + FX income + cash-management fees; monthly and trailing-12 trend. Source: profitability engine / GL mapping.

insights.title: RAROC by client / sector / RM
insights.whatItTells: Risk-adjusted return — the truest profitability lens.
insights.method: RAROC = (revenue − funding cost − operating cost allocation − expected loss) / economic capital, where EC ≈ f(PD, LGD, EAD). Report per client, sector, RM. Source: profitability engine + risk parameters.

insights.title: Fee-based income share of corporate revenue
insights.whatItTells: Quality and stability of the revenue mix.
insights.method: Fee share = total non-interest income / total corporate revenue; mix breakdown by fee type (credit fees, trade, cash management, FX). Trend. Source: GL income accounts.

insights.title: Sector-level P&L contribution
insights.whatItTells: Which industries fund the corporate P&L.
insights.method: Aggregate client-level contribution by sector; treemap sized by revenue, colored by RAROC. Source: profitability engine.

insights.title: Unprofitable relationship identification
insights.whatItTells: The fix-or-exit list.
insights.method: Clients where contribution < 0 or RAROC < hurdle rate; quadrant view: x = revenue, y = RAROC, hurdle line; count and exposure of the unprofitable quadrant. Source: profitability engine.
